   175→// handleLifecycleTurnStart handles turn start: captures pre-prompt state,
   176→// ensures strategy setup, initializes session.
   177→func handleLifecycleTurnStart(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   178→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   179→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-start",
   180→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   181→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   182→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   183→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   184→	)
   185→
   186→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   187→	if sessionID == "" {
   188→		return fmt.Errorf("no session_id in %s event", event.Type)
   189→	}
   190→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   191→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s event: %w", event.Type, err)
   192→	}
   193→
   194→	// Fill model from hint file if the agent didn't provide it on this hook
   195→	if event.Model == "" {
   196→		if hint := strategy.LoadModelHint(ctx, sessionID); hint != "" {
   197→			event.Model = hint
   198→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "loaded model from hint file",
   199→				slog.String("model", hint))
   200→		}
   201→	}
   202→
   203→	// Capture pre-prompt state (including transcript position via TranscriptAnalyzer)
   204→	_, captureSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "capture_pre_prompt_state")
   205→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(ctx, ag, sessionID, event.SessionRef); err != nil {
   206→		captureSpan.RecordError(err)
   207→		captureSpan.End()
   208→		return err
   209→	}
   210→	captureSpan.End()
   211→
   212→	// Append prompt to prompt.txt on filesystem so it's available for
   213→	// mid-turn commits (before SaveStep writes it to the shadow branch).
   214→	// Prompts are separated by "\n\n---\n\n" to support multiple turns.
   215→	if event.Prompt != "" {
   216→		sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   217→		if sessionDirAbs, absErr := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir); absErr == nil {
   218→			if mkErr := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); mkErr == nil {
   219→				promptPath := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   220→				existing, readErr := os.ReadFile(promptPath) //nolint:gosec // session metadata path
   221→				var content string
   222→				if readErr == nil && len(existing) > 0 {
   223→					content = string(existing) + "\n\n---\n\n" + event.Prompt
   224→				} else {
   225→					content = event.Prompt
   226→				}
   227→				if writeErr := os.WriteFile(promptPath, []byte(content), 0o600); writeErr != nil { //nolint:gosec // path from internal metadata, not user input
   228→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to write prompt.txt",
   229→						slog.String("error", writeErr.Error()))
   230→				}
   231→			}
   232→		}
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	// Ensure strategy setup and initialize session
   236→	_, initSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "init_session")
   237→	if err := strategy.EnsureSetup(ctx); err != nil {
   238→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to ensure strategy setup",
   239→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   243→	if err := strat.InitializeSession(ctx, sessionID, ag.Type(), event.SessionRef, event.Prompt, event.Model); err != nil {
   244→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to initialize session state",
   245→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   246→	}
   247→	initSpan.End()
   248→
   249→	return nil
   250→}
   251→
   252→// handleLifecycleTurnEnd handles turn end: validates transcript, extracts metadata,
   253→// detects file changes, saves step + checkpoint, transitions phase.
   254→//
   255→//nolint:maintidx // high complexity due to sequential orchestration of 8 steps (validation, extraction, file detection, filtering, token calc, step save, phase transition, cleanup) - splitting would obscure the flow
   256→func handleLifecycleTurnEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   257→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   258→	logging.Info(logCtx, "turn-end",
   259→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   260→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   261→		slog.String("session_ref", event.SessionRef),
   262→		slog.String("model", event.Model),
   263→	)
   264→
   265→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   266→	if sessionID == "" {
   267→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	// Fill model from hint file if the agent didn't provide it on this hook
   271→	if event.Model == "" && sessionID != unknownSessionID {
   272→		if hint := strategy.LoadModelHint(ctx, sessionID); hint != "" {
   273→			event.Model = hint
   274→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "loaded model from hint file",
   275→				slog.String("model", hint))
   276→		}
   277→	}
   278→
   279→	transcriptRef := event.SessionRef
   280→	if transcriptRef == "" {
   281→		return errors.New("transcript file not specified")
   282→	}
   283→
   284→	// If agent implements TranscriptPreparer, materialize the transcript file.
   285→	// This must run BEFORE fileExists: agents like OpenCode lazily fetch transcripts
   286→	// via `opencode export`, so the file doesn't exist until PrepareTranscript creates it.
   287→	// Claude Code's PrepareTranscript just flushes (always succeeds). Agents without
   288→	// TranscriptPreparer (Gemini, Droid) are unaffected.
   289→	_, prepareSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "prepare_and_validate_transcript")
   290→	if preparer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptPreparer(ag); ok {
   291→		if err := preparer.PrepareTranscript(ctx, transcriptRef); err != nil {
   292→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to prepare transcript",
   293→				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   294→		}
   295→	}
   296→
   297→	if !fileExists(transcriptRef) {
   298→		prepareSpan.RecordError(fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef))
   299→		prepareSpan.End()
   300→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found: %s", transcriptRef)
   301→	}
   302→
   303→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   304→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(ctx); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   305→		prepareSpan.RecordError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   306→		prepareSpan.End()
   307→		logging.Info(logCtx, "skipping checkpoint - will activate after first commit")
   308→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   309→	}
   310→	prepareSpan.End()
   311→
   312→	// Create session metadata directory
   313→	_, copySpan := perf.Start(ctx, "copy_transcript")
   314→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   315→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, sessionDir)
   316→	if err != nil {
   317→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir
   318→	}
   319→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   320→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   321→		copySpan.End()
   322→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   323→	}
   324→
   325→	// Copy transcript to session directory
   326→	transcriptData, err := ag.ReadTranscript(transcriptRef)
   327→	if err != nil {
   328→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   329→		copySpan.End()
   330→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read transcript: %w", err)
   331→	}
   332→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   333→	if err := os.WriteFile(logFile, transcriptData, 0o600); err != nil {
   334→		copySpan.RecordError(err)
   335→		copySpan.End()
   336→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   337→	}
   338→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "copied transcript",
   339→		slog.String("path", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName))
   340→	copySpan.End()
   341→
   342→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on TurnStart)
   343→	_, extractSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "extract_metadata")
   344→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID)
   345→	if err != nil {
   346→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-prompt state",
   347→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   348→	}
   349→
   350→	// Determine transcript offset
   351→	transcriptOffset := resolveTranscriptOffset(ctx, preState, sessionID)
   352→
   353→	// Backfill prompt.txt from transcript when prompt data is missing.
   354→	// This handles agents whose exec mode doesn't fire UserPromptSubmit (e.g., Factory AI
   355→	// Droid). The transcript is the source of truth — if ExtractPrompts returns nothing,
   356→	// there genuinely were no prompts. We track whether backfill occurred so we can
   357→	// update session state after SaveStep (which may reinitialize state).
   358→	var backfilledPrompt string
   359→	promptPath := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   360→	existingPrompt, readPromptErr := os.ReadFile(promptPath) //nolint:gosec // file content is safe session metadata
   361→	if readPromptErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(readPromptErr) {
   362→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to read prompt.txt, skipping backfill",
   363→			slog.String("error", readPromptErr.Error()))
   364→	} else if len(existingPrompt) == 0 {
   365→		if extractor, ok := agent.AsPromptExtractor(ag); ok {
   366→			prompts, extractErr := extractor.ExtractPrompts(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset)
   367→			if extractErr != nil {
   368→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract prompts from transcript",
   369→					slog.String("error", extractErr.Error()))
   370→			} else if len(prompts) > 0 {
   371→				content := strings.Join(prompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   372→				if writeErr := os.WriteFile(promptPath, []byte(content), 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   373→					logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill prompt.txt from transcript",
   374→						slog.String("error", writeErr.Error()))
   375→				} else {
   376→					logging.Debug(logCtx, "backfilled prompt.txt from transcript",
   377→						slog.Int("prompt_count", len(prompts)))
   378→					backfilledPrompt = prompts[len(prompts)-1]
   379→				}
   380→			}
   381→		}
   382→	}
   383→
   384→	// Compute subagents directory for agents that support subagent extraction.
   385→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   386→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptRef), event.SessionID, "subagents")
   387→
   388→	// Extract metadata via agent interface (modified files)
   389→	var modifiedFiles []string
   390→
   391→	if analyzer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptAnalyzer(ag); ok {
   392→		// Extract modified files - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor if available to include subagent files
   393→		if subagentExtractor, subOk := agent.AsSubagentAwareExtractor(ag); subOk {
   394→			if files, fileErr := subagentExtractor.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptData, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir); fileErr != nil {
   395→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files (with subagents)",
   396→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   397→			} else {
   398→				modifiedFiles = files
   399→			}
   400→		} else {
   401→			// Fall back to basic extraction (main transcript only)
   402→			if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptRef, transcriptOffset); fileErr != nil {
   403→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files",
   404→					slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   405→			} else {
   406→				modifiedFiles = files
   407→			}
   408→		}
   409→	}
   410→	extractSpan.End()
   411→
   412→	// Generate commit message from last prompt (read from session state, set at TurnStart).
   413→	// In exec mode, session state LastPrompt may be empty because UserPromptSubmit never fires.
   414→	// Fall back to backfilledPrompt extracted from the transcript.
   415→	_, commitMsgSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "generate_commit_message")
   416→	lastPrompt := ""
   417→	if sessionState, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && sessionState != nil {
   418→		lastPrompt = sessionState.LastPrompt
   419→	}
   420→	if lastPrompt == "" && backfilledPrompt != "" {
   421→		lastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   422→	}
   423→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt, ag.Type())
   424→	logging.Debug(logCtx, "using commit message",
   425→		slog.Int("message_length", len(commitMessage)))
   426→	commitMsgSpan.End()
   427→
   428→	// Get worktree root for path normalization
   429→	_, detectSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "detect_file_changes")
   430→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   431→	if err != nil {
   432→		detectSpan.RecordError(err)
   433→		detectSpan.End()
   434→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   435→	}
   436→
   437→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   438→	if preState != nil {
   439→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state",
   440→			slog.Int("pre_existing_untracked_files", len(preState.UntrackedFiles)))
   441→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   442→	}
   443→
   444→	// Detect file changes via git status
   445→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   446→	if err != nil {
   447→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   448→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   449→	}
   450→	detectSpan.End()
   451→
   452→	// Filter and normalize all paths
   453→	_, normalizeSpan := perf.Start(ctx, "filter_and_normalize_paths")
   454→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   455→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   456→	if changes != nil {
   457→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   458→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   459→
   460→		// Merge git-status modified files as a fallback for transcript parsing.
   461→		// Transcript parsing is the primary source for modified files, but it can miss
   462→		// files if the agent uses an unrecognized tool or the transcript format changes.
   463→		// Git status catches any tracked file with working-tree changes.
   464→		relModifiedFiles = mergeUnique(relModifiedFiles, FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Modified, repoRoot))
   465→	}
   466→
   467→	// Filter transcript-extracted files to exclude files already committed to HEAD.
   468→	// When an agent commits files mid-turn, those files are condensed by PostCommit
   469→	// and should not be re-added to FilesTouched by SaveStep. A file is "committed"
   470→	// if it exists in HEAD with the same content as the working tree.
   471→	relModifiedFiles = filterToUncommittedFiles(ctx, relModifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   472→	normalizeSpan.End()
   473→
   474→	// Backfill session state LastPrompt early so `entire status` shows the prompt
   475→	// even when no files were modified (before the early return below).
   476→	if backfilledPrompt != "" {
   477→		if state, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && state != nil && state.LastPrompt == "" {
   478→			state.LastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   479→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   480→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill LastPrompt in session state",
   481→					slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   482→			}
   483→		}
   484→	}
   485→
   486→	// Check if there are any changes
   487→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   488→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   489→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no files modified during session, skipping checkpoint")
   490→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx, sessionID, event)
   491→		if cleanupErr := CleanupPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID); cleanupErr != nil {
   492→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to cleanup pre-prompt state",
   493→				slog.String("error", cleanupErr.Error()))
   494→		}
   495→		return nil
   496→	}
   497→
   498→	// Log file changes
   499→	logFileChanges(ctx, relModifiedFiles, relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles)
   500→
   501→	// Get git author
   502→	author, err := GetGitAuthor(ctx)
   503→	if err != nil {
   504→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   505→	}
   506→
   507→	// Get strategy and agent type
   508→	strat := GetStrategy(ctx)
   509→	agentType := ag.Type()
   510→
   511→	// Get transcript position/identifier from pre-prompt state
   512→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   513→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   514→	if preState != nil {
   515→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   516→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.TranscriptOffset
   517→	}
   518→
   519→	// Calculate token usage - prefer SubagentAwareExtractor to include subagent tokens
   520→	tokenUsage := agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, transcriptData, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   521→
   522→	// Build fully-populated step context and delegate to strategy
   523→	stepCtx := strategy.StepContext{
   524→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   525→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   526→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   527→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   528→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   529→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   530→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   531→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptRef,
   532→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   533→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   534→		AgentType:                agentType,
   535→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   536→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   537→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   538→	}
   539→
   540→	if err := strat.SaveStep(ctx, stepCtx); err != nil {
   541→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save step: %w", err)
   542→	}
   543→
   544→	// Update session state with backfilled prompt after SaveStep.
   545→	// Done after SaveStep because SaveStep may reinitialize session state,
   546→	// which would overwrite an earlier LastPrompt update.
   547→	if backfilledPrompt != "" {
   548→		if state, stateErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID); stateErr == nil && state != nil && state.LastPrompt == "" {
   549→			state.LastPrompt = backfilledPrompt
   550→			if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, state); saveErr != nil {
   551→				logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to backfill LastPrompt in session state",
   552→					slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   553→			}
   554→		}
   555→	}
   556→
   557→	// Transition session phase and cleanup
   558→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(ctx, sessionID, event)
   559→	if cleanupErr := CleanupPrePromptState(ctx, sessionID); cleanupErr != nil {
   560→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to cleanup pre-prompt state",
   561→			slog.String("error", cleanupErr.Error()))
   562→	}
   563→
   564→	return nil
   565→}

   567→// handleLifecycleCompaction handles context compaction: saves current progress
   568→// but stays in ACTIVE phase (unlike TurnEnd which transitions to IDLE).
   569→// Also resets the transcript offset since the transcript may be truncated.
   570→func handleLifecycleCompaction(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   571→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   572→	logging.Info(logCtx, "compaction",
   573→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   574→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   575→	)
   576→
   577→	// Fire EventCompaction to trigger ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched (stays in ACTIVE)
   578→	sessionID := event.SessionID
   579→	sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   580→	if loadErr != nil {
   581→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state for compaction",
   582→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))
   583→	}
   584→	if sessionState != nil {
   585→		persistEventMetadataToState(event, sessionState)
   586→
   587→		if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, sessionState, session.EventCompaction, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   588→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "compaction transition failed",
   589→				slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))
   590→		}
   591→
   592→		if saveErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(ctx, sessionState); saveErr != nil {
   593→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to save session state after compaction",
   594→				slog.String("error", saveErr.Error()))
   595→		}
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	logging.Info(logCtx, "context compaction detected")
   599→	return nil
   600→}

   602→// handleLifecycleSessionEnd handles session end: marks the session as ended.
   603→func handleLifecycleSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   604→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   605→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   606→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   607→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   608→	)
   609→
   610→	if event.SessionID == "" {
   611→		return nil // No session to update
   612→	}
   613→
   614→	// Note: We intentionally don't clean up cached transcripts here.
   615→	// Post-session commits (carry-forward in ENDED phase) may still need
   616→	// the transcript to extract file changes. Cleanup is handled by
   617→	// `entire clean` or when the session state is fully removed.
   618→
   619→	if err := markSessionEnded(ctx, event, event.SessionID); err != nil {
   620→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to mark session ended",
   621→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   622→	}
   623→	return nil
   624→}

   644→// handleLifecycleSubagentEnd handles subagent end: detects changes, saves task checkpoint.
   645→func handleLifecycleSubagentEnd(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, event *agent.Event) error {
   646→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle"), ag.Name())
   647→	if event.SubagentType == "" && event.TaskDescription == "" {
   648→		// Extract subagent type and description from tool input
   649→		event.SubagentType, event.TaskDescription = ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(event.ToolInput)
   650→	}
   651→
   652→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   653→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(event.SessionRef)
   654→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   655→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   656→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, event.SubagentID)
   657→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   658→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   659→		}
   660→	}
   661→
   662→	// Log context
   663→	subagentEndAttrs := []any{
   664→		slog.String("event", event.Type.String()),
   665→		slog.String("session_id", event.SessionID),
   666→		slog.String("tool_use_id", event.ToolUseID),
   667→	}
   668→	if event.SubagentID != "" {
   669→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("agent_id", event.SubagentID))
   670→	}
   671→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   672→		subagentEndAttrs = append(subagentEndAttrs, slog.String("subagent_transcript", subagentTranscriptPath))
   673→	}
   674→	logging.Info(logCtx, "subagent completed", subagentEndAttrs...)
   675→
   676→	// Extract modified files from hook payload and/or subagent transcript
   677→	var modifiedFiles []string
   678→	modifiedFiles = append(modifiedFiles, event.ModifiedFiles...)
   679→	if analyzer, ok := agent.AsTranscriptAnalyzer(ag); ok {
   680→		transcriptToScan := event.SessionRef
   681→		if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   682→			transcriptToScan = subagentTranscriptPath
   683→		}
   684→		if files, _, fileErr := analyzer.ExtractModifiedFilesFromOffset(transcriptToScan, 0); fileErr != nil {
   685→			logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to extract modified files from subagent",
   686→				slog.String("error", fileErr.Error()))
   687→		} else {
   688→			modifiedFiles = mergeUnique(modifiedFiles, files)
   689→		}
   690→	}
   691→
   692→	// Load pre-task state and detect file changes.
   693→	// If no pre-task state exists (agent doesn't support pre-task hook), fall back
   694→	// to the session's pre-prompt state. Without either, DetectFileChanges receives
   695→	// nil and treats ALL untracked files as new — which would create spurious task
   696→	// checkpoints for pre-existing untracked files (e.g., .github/hooks/entire.json).
   697→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(ctx, event.ToolUseID)
   698→	if err != nil {
   699→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load pre-task state",
   700→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   701→	}
   702→	var preUntrackedFiles []string
   703→	if preState != nil {
   704→		preUntrackedFiles = preState.PreUntrackedFiles()
   705→	}
   706→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(ctx, preUntrackedFiles)
   707→	if err != nil {
   708→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to compute file changes",
   709→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   710→	}
   711→
   712→	// Get worktree root and normalize paths
   713→	repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
   714→	if err != nil {
   715→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree root: %w", err)
   716→	}
   717→
   718→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   719→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   720→	if changes != nil {
   721→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   722→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)

   781→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "lifecycle")

   783→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "pre-prompt state found, parsing transcript from offset",
   784→			slog.Int("offset", preState.TranscriptOffset))
   785→		return preState.TranscriptOffset

   788→	// Fall back to session state

   791→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to load session state",
   792→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))

   797→			slog.Int("offset", sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart))

   820→			slog.String("error", loadErr.Error()))

   822→	}

   824→		return

   829→	if err := strategy.TransitionAndLog(ctx, turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); err != nil {

   831→			slog.String("error", err.Error()))

   835→	// work items from state (e.g. TurnCheckpointIDs), not the action list.

   850→func markSessionEnded(ctx context.Context, event *agent.Event, sessionID string) error {

   852→	if err != nil {

   854→	}
   855→	if state == nil {

   859→	if event != nil {

   865→			slog.String("error", transErr.Error()))

   886→func persistEventMetadataToState(event *agent.Event, state *strategy.SessionState) {

   910→	}

    13→// resolveTranscriptPath returns the current path to the session's transcript file.
    14→// If the file exists at state.TranscriptPath, that path is returned immediately.
    15→//
    16→// If the file is missing (os.ErrNotExist), the function re-resolves the path
    17→// using the agent's ResolveSessionFile method. This handles agents that relocate
    18→// transcripts mid-session (e.g., Cursor CLI switching from a flat layout
    19→// <dir>/<id>.jsonl to a nested layout <dir>/<id>/<id>.jsonl).
    20→//
    21→// On successful re-resolution, state.TranscriptPath is updated so that
    22→// subsequent reads use the correct path without repeating the resolution.
    23→func resolveTranscriptPath(state *SessionState) (string, error) {
    24→	if state.TranscriptPath == "" {
    25→		return "", errors.New("no transcript path in session state")
    26→	}
    27→
    28→	// Fast path: file exists at the stored location.
    29→	if _, err := os.Stat(state.TranscriptPath); err == nil {
    30→		return state.TranscriptPath, nil
    31→	} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
    32→		// Non-ENOENT error (permission denied, etc.) — return as-is.
    33→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to access transcript: %w", err)
    34→	}
    35→
    36→	// File not found — attempt re-resolution via the agent.
    37→	ag, agErr := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType)
    38→	if agErr != nil {
    39→		return "", fmt.Errorf("transcript not found at %s: %w", state.TranscriptPath, os.ErrNotExist)
    40→	}
    41→
    42→	// Extract the session dir and agent session ID from the stored path.
    43→	// Stored path format: <sessionDir>/<agentSessionID>.jsonl
    44→	sessionDir := filepath.Dir(state.TranscriptPath)
    45→	base := filepath.Base(state.TranscriptPath)
    46→	agentSessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(base, filepath.Ext(base))
    47→
    48→	resolved := ag.ResolveSessionFile(sessionDir, agentSessionID)
    49→	if resolved == state.TranscriptPath {
    50→		// Agent resolved to the same path — file genuinely doesn't exist.
    51→		return "", fmt.Errorf("transcript not found at %s: %w", state.TranscriptPath, os.ErrNotExist)
    52→	}
    53→
    54→	// Check if the re-resolved path exists.
    55→	if _, err := os.Stat(resolved); err != nil {
    56→		return "", fmt.Errorf("transcript not found at %s (also tried %s): %w", state.TranscriptPath, resolved, os.ErrNotExist)
    57→	}
    58→
    59→	// Update state so subsequent reads use the correct path.
    60→	state.TranscriptPath = resolved
    61→	return resolved, nil
    62→}

   185→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   186→	if err != nil {
   187→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   188→	}
   189→
   190→	// Get author info
   191→	authorName, authorEmail := GetGitAuthorFromRepo(repo)
   192→
   193→	// Determine attribution base commit
   194→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   195→	if attrBase == "" {
   196→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit
   197→	}
   198→
   199→	attribution := calculateSessionAttributions(ctx, repo, ref, sessionData, state, attributionOpts{
   200→		headTree:              o.headTree,
   201→		repoDir:               o.repoDir,
   202→		attributionBaseCommit: attrBase,
   203→		headCommitHash:        o.headCommitHash,
   204→	})
   205→
   206→	// Get current branch name
   207→	branchName := GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   208→
   209→	// Generate summary if enabled
   210→	var summary *cpkg.Summary
   211→	if settings.IsSummarizeEnabled(ctx) && len(sessionData.Transcript) > 0 {
   212→		summarizeCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "summarize")
   213→
   214→		var scopedTranscript []byte
   215→		switch state.AgentType {
   216→		case agent.AgentTypeGemini:
   217→			scoped, sliceErr := geminicli.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   218→			if sliceErr != nil {
   219→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope Gemini transcript for summary",
   220→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   221→					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
   222→			}
   223→			scopedTranscript = scoped
   224→		case agent.AgentTypeOpenCode:
   225→			scoped, sliceErr := opencode.SliceFromMessage(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   226→			if sliceErr != nil {
   227→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "failed to scope OpenCode transcript for summary",
   228→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   229→					slog.String("error", sliceErr.Error()))
   230→			}
   231→			scopedTranscript = scoped
   232→		case agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode, agent.AgentTypeCursor, agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid, agent.AgentTypeUnknown:
   233→			scopedTranscript = transcript.SliceFromLine(sessionData.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart)
   234→		}
   235→		if len(scopedTranscript) > 0 {
   236→			var err error
   237→			summary, err = summarize.GenerateFromTranscript(summarizeCtx, scopedTranscript, sessionData.FilesTouched, state.AgentType, nil)
   238→			if err != nil {
   239→				logging.Warn(summarizeCtx, "summary generation failed",
   240→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID),
   241→					slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   242→			} else {
   243→				logging.Info(summarizeCtx, "summary generated",
   244→					slog.String("session_id", state.SessionID))
   245→			}
   246→		}
   247→	}
   248→
   249→	// Write checkpoint metadata using the checkpoint store
   250→	if err := store.WriteCommitted(ctx, cpkg.WriteCommittedOptions{
   251→		CheckpointID:                checkpointID,
   252→		SessionID:                   state.SessionID,
   253→		Strategy:                    StrategyNameManualCommit,
   254→		Branch:                      branchName,
   255→		Transcript:                  sessionData.Transcript,
   256→		Prompts:                     sessionData.Prompts,
   257→		FilesTouched:                sessionData.FilesTouched,
   258→		CheckpointsCount:            state.StepCount,
   259→		EphemeralBranch:             shadowBranchName,
   260→		AuthorName:                  authorName,
   261→		AuthorEmail:                 authorEmail,
   262→		Agent:                       state.AgentType,
   263→		Model:                       state.ModelName,
   264→		TurnID:                      state.TurnID,
   265→		TranscriptIdentifierAtStart: state.TranscriptIdentifierAtStart,
   266→		CheckpointTranscriptStart:   state.CheckpointTranscriptStart,
   267→		TokenUsage:                  sessionData.TokenUsage,
   268→		SessionMetrics:              buildSessionMetrics(state),
   269→		InitialAttribution:          attribution,
   270→		Summary:                     summary,
   271→	}); err != nil {
   272→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to write checkpoint metadata: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	return &CondenseResult{
   276→		CheckpointID:         checkpointID,
   277→		SessionID:            state.SessionID,
   278→		CheckpointsCount:     state.StepCount,
   279→		FilesTouched:         sessionData.FilesTouched,
   280→		Prompts:              sessionData.Prompts,
   281→		TotalTranscriptLines: sessionData.FullTranscriptLines,
   282→		Transcript:           sessionData.Transcript,
   283→	}, nil
   284→}

   300→// attributionOpts provides pre-resolved git objects to avoid redundant reads.
   301→type attributionOpts struct {
   302→	headTree              *object.Tree // HEAD commit tree (already resolved by PostCommit)
   303→	shadowTree            *object.Tree // Shadow branch tree (already resolved by PostCommit)
   304→	repoDir               string       // Repository worktree path for git CLI commands
   305→	attributionBaseCommit string       // Base commit hash for non-agent file detection (empty = fall back to go-git tree walk)
   306→	headCommitHash        string       // HEAD commit hash for non-agent file detection (empty = fall back to go-git tree walk)
   307→}
   308→
   309→func calculateSessionAttributions(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef *plumbing.Reference, sessionData *ExtractedSessionData, state *SessionState, opts ...attributionOpts) *cpkg.InitialAttribution {
   310→	// Calculate initial attribution using accumulated prompt attribution data.
   311→	// This uses user edits captured at each prompt start (before agent works),
   312→	// plus any user edits after the final checkpoint (shadow → head).
   313→	//
   314→	// When shadowRef is nil (agent committed mid-turn before SaveStep),
   315→	// HEAD is used as the shadow tree. This is correct because the agent's
   316→	// commit IS HEAD — there are no user edits between agent work and commit.
   317→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "attribution")
   318→
   319→	var o attributionOpts
   320→	if len(opts) > 0 {
   321→		o = opts[0]
   322→	}
   323→
   324→	headTree := o.headTree
   325→	if headTree == nil {
   326→		headRef, headErr := repo.Head()
   327→		if headErr != nil {
   328→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD",
   329→				slog.String("error", headErr.Error()))
   330→			return nil
   331→		}
   332→
   333→		headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(headRef.Hash())
   334→		if commitErr != nil {
   335→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD commit",
   336→				slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
   337→			return nil
   338→		}
   339→
   340→		var treeErr error
   341→		headTree, treeErr = headCommit.Tree()
   342→		if treeErr != nil {
   343→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get HEAD tree",
   344→				slog.String("error", treeErr.Error()))
   345→			return nil
   346→		}
   347→	}
   348→
   349→	// Get shadow tree: from pre-resolved cache, shadow branch, or HEAD (agent committed directly).
   350→	shadowTree := o.shadowTree
   351→	if shadowTree == nil {
   352→		if shadowRef != nil {
   353→			shadowCommit, shadowErr := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef.Hash())
   354→			if shadowErr != nil {
   355→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow commit",
   356→					slog.String("error", shadowErr.Error()),
   357→					slog.String("shadow_ref", shadowRef.Hash().String()))
   358→				return nil
   359→			}
   360→			var shadowTreeErr error
   361→			shadowTree, shadowTreeErr = shadowCommit.Tree()
   362→			if shadowTreeErr != nil {
   363→				logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution skipped: failed to get shadow tree",
   364→					slog.String("error", shadowTreeErr.Error()))
   365→				return nil
   366→			}
   367→		} else {
   368→			// No shadow branch: agent committed mid-turn. Use HEAD as shadow
   369→			// because the agent's work is the commit itself.
   370→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: using HEAD as shadow (no shadow branch)")
   371→			shadowTree = headTree
   372→		}
   373→	}
   374→
   375→	// Get base tree (state before session started)
   376→	var baseTree *object.Tree
   377→	attrBase := state.AttributionBaseCommit
   378→	if attrBase == "" {
   379→		attrBase = state.BaseCommit // backward compat
   380→	}
   381→	if baseCommit, baseErr := repo.CommitObject(plumbing.NewHash(attrBase)); baseErr == nil {
   382→		if tree, baseTErr := baseCommit.Tree(); baseTErr == nil {
   383→			baseTree = tree
   384→		} else {
   385→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base tree unavailable",
   386→				slog.String("error", baseTErr.Error()))
   387→		}
   388→	} else {
   389→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "attribution: base commit unavailable",
   390→			slog.String("error", baseErr.Error()),
   391→			slog.String("attribution_base", attrBase))
   392→	}
   393→
   394→	// Log accumulated prompt attributions for debugging
   395→	var totalUserAdded, totalUserRemoved int
   396→	for i, pa := range state.PromptAttributions {
   397→		totalUserAdded += pa.UserLinesAdded
   398→		totalUserRemoved += pa.UserLinesRemoved
   399→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "prompt attribution data",
   400→			slog.Int("checkpoint", pa.CheckpointNumber),
   401→			slog.Int("user_added", pa.UserLinesAdded),
   402→			slog.Int("user_removed", pa.UserLinesRemoved),
   403→			slog.Int("agent_added", pa.AgentLinesAdded),
   404→			slog.Int("agent_removed", pa.AgentLinesRemoved),
   405→			slog.Int("index", i))
   406→	}
   407→
   408→	attribution := CalculateAttributionWithAccumulated(
   409→		ctx,
   410→		baseTree,
   411→		shadowTree,
   412→		headTree,
   413→		sessionData.FilesTouched,
   414→		state.PromptAttributions,
   415→		o.repoDir,
   416→		o.attributionBaseCommit,
   417→		o.headCommitHash,
   418→	)
   419→
   420→	if attribution != nil {
   421→		logging.Info(logCtx, "attribution calculated",
   422→			slog.Int("agent_lines", attribution.AgentLines),
   423→			slog.Int("human_added", attribution.HumanAdded),
   424→			slog.Int("human_modified", attribution.HumanModified),
   425→			slog.Int("human_removed", attribution.HumanRemoved),
   426→			slog.Int("total_committed", attribution.TotalCommitted),
   427→			slog.Float64("agent_percentage", attribution.AgentPercentage),
   428→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_added", totalUserAdded),
   429→			slog.Int("accumulated_user_removed", totalUserRemoved),
   430→			slog.Int("files_touched", len(sessionData.FilesTouched)))
   431→	}
   432→
   433→	return attribution
   434→}

   436→// extractSessionData extracts session data from the shadow branch.
   437→// filesTouched is the list of files tracked during the session (from SessionState.FilesTouched).
   438→// agentType identifies the agent (e.g., "Gemini CLI", "Claude Code") to determine transcript format.
   439→// liveTranscriptPath, when non-empty and readable, is preferred over the shadow branch copy.
   440→// This handles the case where SaveStep was skipped (no code changes) but the transcript
   441→// continued growing — the shadow branch copy would be stale.
   442→// checkpointTranscriptStart is the line offset (Claude) or message index (Gemini) where the current checkpoint began.
   443→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionData(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, shadowRef plumbing.Hash, sessionID string, filesTouched []string, agentType types.AgentType, liveTranscriptPath string, checkpointTranscriptStart int, isActive bool) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   444→	ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(agentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
   445→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(shadowRef)
   446→	if err != nil {
   447→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   448→	}
   449→
   450→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   451→	if err != nil {
   452→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit tree: %w", err)
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   456→	// sessionID is already an "entire session ID" (with date prefix)
   457→	metadataDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   458→
   459→	// Extract transcript — prefer the live file when available, fall back to shadow branch.
   460→	// The shadow branch copy may be stale if the last turn ended without code changes
   461→	// (SaveStep is only called when there are file modifications).
   462→	var fullTranscript string
   463→	if liveTranscriptPath != "" {
   464→		// Ensure transcript file exists (OpenCode creates it lazily via `opencode export`).
   465→		// Only wait for flush when the session is active — for idle/ended sessions the
   466→		// transcript is already fully flushed (the Stop hook completed the flush).
   467→		if isActive {
   468→			prepareTranscriptIfNeeded(ctx, ag, liveTranscriptPath)
   469→		}
   470→		if liveData, readErr := os.ReadFile(liveTranscriptPath); readErr == nil && len(liveData) > 0 { //nolint:gosec // path from session state
   471→			fullTranscript = string(liveData)
   472→		}
   473→	}
   474→	if fullTranscript == "" {
   475→		// Fall back to shadow branch copy
   476→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   477→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   478→				fullTranscript = content
   479→			}
   480→		} else if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy); fileErr == nil {
   481→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil {
   482→				fullTranscript = content
   483→			}
   484→		}
   485→	}
   486→
   487→	// Process transcript based on agent type
   488→	if fullTranscript != "" {
   489→		data.Transcript = []byte(fullTranscript)
   490→		data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(agentType, fullTranscript)
   491→		// Read prompts from shadow branch tree (source of truth after SaveStep)
   492→		if file, fileErr := tree.File(metadataDir + "/" + paths.PromptFileName); fileErr == nil {
   493→			if content, contentErr := file.Contents(); contentErr == nil && content != "" {
   494→				data.Prompts = splitPromptContent(content)
   495→			}
   496→		}
   497→		// Filesystem fallback (written at turn start, covers mid-turn commits)
   498→		if len(data.Prompts) == 0 {
   499→			data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, sessionID)
   500→		}
   501→	}
   502→
   503→	// Use tracked files from session state (not all files in tree)
   504→	data.FilesTouched = filesTouched
   505→
   506→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   507→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   508→		data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, checkpointTranscriptStart, "") //TODO: why do we not use here subagents dir?
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	return data, nil
   512→}
   513→
   514→// extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript extracts session data directly from the live transcript file.
   515→// This is used for mid-session commits where no shadow branch exists yet.
   516→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) extractSessionDataFromLiveTranscript(ctx context.Context, state *SessionState) (*ExtractedSessionData, error) {
   517→	data := &ExtractedSessionData{}
   518→
   519→	ag, _ := agent.GetByAgentType(state.AgentType) //nolint:errcheck // ag may be nil for unknown agent types; callers use type assertions so nil is safe
   520→
   521→	// Resolve the transcript path (handles agents that relocate mid-session).
   522→	transcriptPath, resolveErr := resolveTranscriptPath(state)
   523→	if resolveErr != nil {
   524→		return nil, resolveErr
   525→	}
   526→
   527→	liveData, err := os.ReadFile(transcriptPath) //nolint:gosec // path validated by resolveTranscriptPath
   528→	if err != nil {
   529→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read live transcript: %w", err)
   530→	}
   531→
   532→	if len(liveData) == 0 {
   533→		return nil, errors.New("live transcript is empty")
   534→	}
   535→
   536→	fullTranscript := string(liveData)
   537→	data.Transcript = liveData
   538→	data.FullTranscriptLines = countTranscriptItems(state.AgentType, fullTranscript)
   539→	data.Prompts = readPromptsFromFilesystem(ctx, state.SessionID)
   540→
   541→	// Resolve files touched: prefers hook-populated state, falls back to transcript extraction
   542→	data.FilesTouched = s.resolveFilesTouched(ctx, state)
   543→
   544→	// Calculate token usage from the extracted transcript portion
   545→	if len(data.Transcript) > 0 {
   546→		data.TokenUsage = agent.CalculateTokenUsage(ctx, ag, data.Transcript, state.CheckpointTranscriptStart, "") //TODO: why do we not use here subagents dir?
   547→	}
   548→
   549→	return data, nil
   550→}

   552→// countTranscriptItems counts lines (JSONL) or messages (JSON) in a transcript.
   553→// For Claude Code and JSONL-based agents, this counts lines.
   554→// For Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and JSON-based agents, this counts messages.
   555→// Returns 0 if the content is empty or malformed.
   556→func countTranscriptItems(agentType types.AgentType, content string) int {
   557→	if content == "" {
   558→		return 0
   559→	}
   560→
   561→	// OpenCode uses export JSON format with {"info": {...}, "messages": [...]}
   562→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   563→		session, err := opencode.ParseExportSession([]byte(content))
   564→		if err == nil && session != nil {
   565→			return len(session.Messages)
   566→		}
   567→		return 0
   568→	}
   569→
   570→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   571→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   572→		transcript, err := geminicli.ParseTranscript([]byte(content))
   573→		if err == nil && transcript != nil && len(transcript.Messages) > 0 {
   574→			return len(transcript.Messages)
   575→		}
   576→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return 0
   577→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   578→			return 0
   579→		}
   580→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   581→	}
   582→
   583→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   584→	allLines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
   585→	// Trim trailing empty lines (from final \n in JSONL)
   586→	for len(allLines) > 0 && strings.TrimSpace(allLines[len(allLines)-1]) == "" {
   587→		allLines = allLines[:len(allLines)-1]
   588→	}
   589→	return len(allLines)
   590→}

   592→// extractUserPrompts extracts all user prompts from transcript content.
   593→// Returns prompts with IDE context tags stripped (e.g., <ide_opened_file>).
   594→func extractUserPrompts(agentType types.AgentType, content string) []string {
   595→	if content == "" {
   596→		return nil
   597→	}
   598→
   599→	// Droid has its own envelope format — use its parser to normalize first
   600→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeFactoryAIDroid {
   601→		lines, _, err := factoryaidroid.ParseDroidTranscriptFromBytes([]byte(content), 0)
   602→		if err != nil {
   603→			return nil
   604→		}
   605→		var prompts []string
   606→		for _, line := range lines {
   607→			if line.Type != transcript.TypeUser {
   608→				continue
   609→			}
   610→			if text := transcript.ExtractUserContent(line.Message); text != "" {
   611→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(text); stripped != "" {
   612→					prompts = append(prompts, stripped)
   613→				}
   614→			}
   615→		}
   616→		return prompts
   617→	}
   618→
   619→	// OpenCode uses JSONL with a different per-line schema than Claude Code
   620→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeOpenCode {
   621→		prompts, err := opencode.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   622→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   623→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   624→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   625→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   626→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   627→				}
   628→			}
   629→			return cleaned
   630→		}
   631→		return nil
   632→	}
   633→
   634→	// Try Gemini format first if agentType is Gemini, or as fallback if Unknown
   635→	if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini || agentType == agent.AgentTypeUnknown {
   636→		prompts, err := geminicli.ExtractAllUserPrompts([]byte(content))
   637→		if err == nil && len(prompts) > 0 {
   638→			// Strip IDE context tags for consistency with Claude Code handling
   639→			cleaned := make([]string, 0, len(prompts))
   640→			for _, prompt := range prompts {
   641→				if stripped := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(prompt); stripped != "" {
   642→					cleaned = append(cleaned, stripped)
   643→				}
   644→			}
   645→			return cleaned
   646→		}
   647→		// If agentType is explicitly Gemini but parsing failed, return nil
   648→		if agentType == agent.AgentTypeGemini {
   649→			return nil
   650→		}
   651→		// Otherwise fall through to JSONL parsing for Unknown type
   652→	}
   653→
   654→	// Claude Code and other JSONL-based agents
   655→	return extractUserPromptsFromLines(strings.Split(content, "\n"))
   656→}
   657→
   658→// extractUserPromptsFromLines extracts user prompts from JSONL transcript lines.
   659→// IDE-injected context tags (like <ide_opened_file>) are stripped from the results.
   660→func extractUserPromptsFromLines(lines []string) []string {
   661→	var prompts []string
   662→	for _, line := range lines {
   663→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
   664→		if line == "" {
   665→			continue
   666→		}
   667→
   668→		var entry map[string]interface{}
   669→		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry); err != nil {
   670→			continue
   671→		}
   672→
   673→		// Check for user message:
   674→		// - Claude Code uses "type": "human" or "type": "user"
   675→		// - Cursor uses "role": "user"
   676→		msgType, _ := entry["type"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
   677→		msgRole, _ := entry["role"].(string) //nolint:errcheck // type assertion on interface{} from JSON
   678→		isUser := msgType == "human" || msgType == "user" || msgRole == "user"
   679→		if !isUser {
   680→			continue
   681→		}
   682→
   683→		// Extract message content
   684→		message, ok := entry["message"].(map[string]interface{})
   685→		if !ok {
   686→			continue
   687→		}
   688→
   689→		// Handle string content
   690→		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok && content != "" {
   691→			cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(content)
   692→			if cleaned != "" {
   693→				prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   694→			}
   695→			continue
   696→		}
   697→
   698→		// Handle array content (e.g., multiple text blocks from VSCode)
   699→		if arr, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
   700→			var texts []string
   701→			for _, item := range arr {
   702→				if m, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
   703→					if m["type"] == "text" {
   704→						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok {
   705→							texts = append(texts, text)
   706→						}
   707→					}
   708→				}
   709→			}
   710→			if len(texts) > 0 {
   711→				cleaned := textutil.StripIDEContextTags(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"))
   712→				if cleaned != "" {
   713→					prompts = append(prompts, cleaned)
   714→				}
   715→			}
   716→		}
   717→	}
   718→	return prompts
   719→}

   721→// splitPromptContent splits prompt.txt content on the "\n\n---\n\n" separator.
   722→// Returns nil if content is empty.
   723→func splitPromptContent(content string) []string {
   724→	if content == "" {
   725→		return nil
   726→	}
   727→	parts := strings.Split(content, "\n\n---\n\n")
   728→	var result []string
   729→	for _, p := range parts {
   730→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(p)
   731→		if trimmed != "" {
   732→			result = append(result, trimmed)
   733→		}
   734→	}
   735→	return result
   736→}

   740→// even for mid-turn commits where the shadow branch may not have been updated.

   766→// CondenseSessionByID force-condenses a session by its ID and cleans up.
   767→// This is used by "entire doctor" to salvage stuck sessions.
   768→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CondenseSessionByID(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   769→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "condense-by-id")
   770→
   771→	// Load session state
   772→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(ctx, sessionID)
   773→	if err != nil {
   774→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   775→	}
   776→	if state == nil {
   777→		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
   778→	}
   779→
   780→	// Open repository
   781→	repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
   782→	if err != nil {
   783→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   784→	}
   785→
   786→	// Generate a checkpoint ID
   787→	checkpointID, err := id.Generate()
   788→	if err != nil {
   789→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate checkpoint ID: %w", err)
   790→	}
   791→
   792→	// Check if shadow branch exists (required for condensation)
   793→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   794→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   795→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   796→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   797→
   798→	if !hasShadowBranch {
   799→		// No shadow branch means no checkpoint data to condense.
   800→		// Just clean up the state file.
   801→		logging.Info(logCtx, "no shadow branch for session, clearing state only",
   802→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   803→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   804→		)
   805→		if err := s.clearSessionState(ctx, sessionID); err != nil {
   806→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   807→		}
   808→		return nil
   809→	}
   810→
   811→	// Condense the session
   812→	result, err := s.CondenseSession(ctx, repo, checkpointID, state, nil)
   813→	if err != nil {
   814→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to condense session: %w", err)
   815→	}
   816→
   817→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session condensed by ID",
   818→		slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   819→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", result.CheckpointID.String()),
   820→		slog.Int("checkpoints_condensed", result.CheckpointsCount),
   821→	)
   822→
   823→	// Update session state: reset step count and transition to idle
   824→	state.StepCount = 0
   825→	state.CheckpointTranscriptStart = result.TotalTranscriptLines
   826→	state.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   827→	state.LastCheckpointID = checkpointID
   828→	state.AttributionBaseCommit = state.BaseCommit
   829→	state.PromptAttributions = nil
   830→	state.PendingPromptAttribution = nil
   831→
   832→	if err := s.saveSessionState(ctx, state); err != nil {
   833→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   834→	}
   835→
   836→	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
   837→	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx, repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
   838→		logging.Warn(logCtx, "failed to clean up shadow branch",
   839→			slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   840→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   841→		)
   842→		// Non-fatal: condensation succeeded, shadow branch cleanup is best-effort
   843→	}
   844→
   845→	return nil
   846→}
   847→
   848→// cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused deletes a shadow branch if no other active sessions reference it.
   849→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(ctx context.Context, _ *git.Repository, shadowBranchName, excludeSessionID string) error {
   850→	// List all session states to check if any other session uses this shadow branch
   851→	allStates, err := s.listAllSessionStates(ctx)
   852→	if err != nil {
   853→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   854→	}
   855→
   856→	for _, state := range allStates {
   857→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   858→			continue
   859→		}
   860→		otherShadow := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   861→		if otherShadow == shadowBranchName && state.StepCount > 0 {
   862→			// Another session still needs this shadow branch
   863→			return nil
   864→		}
   865→	}
   866→
   867→	// No other sessions need it, delete the shadow branch via CLI
   868→	// (go-git v5's RemoveReference doesn't persist with packed refs/worktrees)
   869→	if err := DeleteBranchCLI(ctx, shadowBranchName); err != nil {
   870→		// Branch already gone is not an error
   871→		if errors.Is(err, ErrBranchNotFound) {
   872→			return nil
   873→		}
   874→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove shadow branch: %w", err)
   875→	}
   876→	return nil
   877→}

    39→// hasTTY checks if /dev/tty is available for interactive prompts.
    40→// Returns false when running as an agent subprocess (no controlling terminal).
    41→//
    42→// In test environments, ENTIRE_TEST_TTY overrides the real check:
    43→//   - ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 → simulate human (TTY available)
    44→//   - ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=0 → simulate agent (no TTY)
    45→func hasTTY() bool {
    46→	if v := os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_TTY"); v != "" {
    47→		return v == "1"
    48→	}
    49→
    50→	// Gemini CLI sets GEMINI_CLI=1 when running shell commands.
    51→	// Gemini subprocesses may have access to the user's TTY, but they can't
    52→	// actually respond to interactive prompts. Treat them as non-TTY.
    53→	// See: https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/shell/
    54→	if os.Getenv("GEMINI_CLI") != "" {
    55→		return false
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	// Copilot CLI sets COPILOT_CLI=1 when running hook subprocesses (v0.0.421+).
    59→	// Like Gemini, the subprocess may inherit the user's TTY but can't respond
    60→	// to interactive prompts.
    61→	if os.Getenv("COPILOT_CLI") != "" {
    62→		return false
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	// GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 disables git's own terminal prompts.
    66→	// Factory AI Droid (and other non-interactive environments like CI) set this.
    67→	// Since we run as a git hook, respect it — if the environment doesn't want
    68→	// git prompting, our hook shouldn't prompt either.
    69→	if os.Getenv("GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT") == "0" {
    70→		return false
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
    74→	if err != nil {
    75→		return false
    76→	}
    77→	_ = tty.Close()
    78→	return true
    79→}
    80→
    81→// ttyResult represents the outcome of a TTY confirmation prompt.
    82→type ttyResult int
    83→
    84→const (
    85→	ttyResultLink       ttyResult = iota // Link: add the checkpoint trailer
    86→	ttyResultSkip                        // Skip: don't add the trailer
    87→	ttyResultLinkAlways                  // Link and remember: add trailer + save "always" preference
    88→)
    89→
    90→// askConfirmTTY prompts the user via /dev/tty whether to link a commit to session context.
    91→// This requires a controlling terminal — callers must check hasTTY() first and handle
    92→// the no-TTY case (agent subprocesses, CI) themselves.
    93→//
    94→// header is displayed as the first line (e.g., "Entire: Active Claude Code session").
    95→// detail lines are displayed indented below the header.
    96→func askConfirmTTY(header string, details []string, prompt string, defaultYes bool) ttyResult {
    97→	defaultResult := ttyResultSkip
    98→	if defaultYes {
    99→		defaultResult = ttyResultLink
   100→	}
   101→
   102→	// In test mode, don't try to interact with the real TTY — just use the default.
   103→	// ENTIRE_TEST_TTY=1 simulates "a human is present" for the hasTTY() check
   104→	// but we can't actually read from the TTY in tests.
   105→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_TEST_TTY") != "" {
   106→		return defaultResult
   107→	}
   108→
   109→	// Open /dev/tty for both reading and writing.
   110→	// This is the controlling terminal, which works even when stdin/stderr are redirected
   111→	// (e.g., human runs git commit -m where stdin is not a pipe).
   112→	tty, err := os.OpenFile("/dev/tty", os.O_RDWR, 0)
   113→	if err != nil {
   114→		return defaultResult
   115→	}
   116→	defer tty.Close()
   117→
   118→	// Write to tty directly, not stderr, since git hooks may redirect stderr to /dev/null
   119→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "\n%s\n", header)
   120→	for _, line := range details {
   121→		fmt.Fprintf(tty, "  %s\n", line)
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	// Show prompt with option descriptions
   125→	fmt.Fprintf(tty, "\n%s\n", prompt)
   126→	if defaultYes {
   127→		fmt.Fprint(tty, "  [Y]es / [n]o / [a]lways (remember my choice): ")
   128→	} else {
   129→		fmt.Fprint(tty, "  [y]es / [N]o / [a]lways (remember my choice): ")
   130→	}
   131→
   132→	// Read response
   133→	reader := bufio.NewReader(tty)
   134→	response, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
   135→	if err != nil {
   136→		return defaultResult
   137→	}
   138→
   139→	response = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(response))
   140→	switch response {
   141→	case "y", "yes":
   142→		return ttyResultLink
   143→	case "n", "no":
   144→		return ttyResultSkip
   145→	case "a", "always":
   146→		return ttyResultLinkAlways
   147→	default:
   148→		// Empty or invalid input - use default
   149→		return defaultResult
   150→	}
   151→}

   153→// saveCommitLinkingAlways persists commit_linking = "always" to settings.local.json.
   154→// Uses raw JSON merge to set only the commit_linking field without affecting other
   155→// fields. This avoids writing unintended defaults (e.g., enabled: true) when the
   156→// local settings file doesn't exist yet.
   157→func saveCommitLinkingAlways(ctx context.Context) error {
   158→	localPath, err := paths.AbsPath(ctx, settings.EntireSettingsLocalFile)
   159→	if err != nil {
   160→		return fmt.Errorf("resolving local settings path: %w", err)
   161→	}
   162→
   163→	// Read existing file as raw JSON map to preserve all existing fields.
   164→	// If the file doesn't exist, start with an empty map so we only write commit_linking.
   165→	var raw map[string]json.RawMessage
   166→	data, readErr := os.ReadFile(localPath) //nolint:gosec // path is from AbsPath
   167→	if readErr == nil {
   168→		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
   169→			return fmt.Errorf("parsing local settings: %w", err)
   170→		}
   171→	} else if !os.IsNotExist(readErr) {
   172→		return fmt.Errorf("reading local settings: %w", readErr)
   173→	}
   174→	if raw == nil {
   175→		raw = make(map[string]json.RawMessage)
   176→	}
   177→
   178→	raw["commit_linking"] = json.RawMessage(`"` + settings.CommitLinkingAlways + `"`)
   179→
   180→	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(raw, "", "  ")
   181→	if err != nil {
   182→		return fmt.Errorf("marshaling local settings: %w", err)
   183→	}
   184→	out = append(out, '\n')
   185→
   186→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(localPath), 0o750); err != nil {
   187→		return fmt.Errorf("creating settings directory: %w", err)
   188→	}
   189→	//nolint:gosec // G306: settings file is config, not secrets; 0o644 is appropriate
   190→	if err := os.WriteFile(localPath, out, 0o644); err != nil {
   191→		return fmt.Errorf("writing local settings: %w", err)
   192→	}
   193→	return nil
   194→}

   142→	// Deprecated: TranscriptLinesAtStart is replaced by CheckpointTranscriptStart.
   143→	// Kept for backward compatibility with existing state files.

   167→// PromptAttribution captures line-level attribution data at the start of each prompt.
   168→// By recording what changed since the last checkpoint BEFORE the agent works,
   169→// we can accurately separate user edits from agent contributions.
   170→type PromptAttribution struct {
   171→	// CheckpointNumber is which checkpoint this was recorded before (1-indexed)
   172→	CheckpointNumber int `json:"checkpoint_number"`

   174→	// UserLinesAdded is lines added by user since the last checkpoint

   178→	UserLinesRemoved int `json:"user_lines_removed"`

   181→	// Always 0 for checkpoint 1 since there's no previous checkpoint to measure against.
   182→	AgentLinesAdded int `json:"agent_lines_added"`
   183→
   184→	// AgentLinesRemoved is total agent lines removed so far (base → last checkpoint).
   185→	// Always 0 for checkpoint 1 since there's no previous checkpoint to measure against.
   186→	AgentLinesRemoved int `json:"agent_lines_removed"`

   188→	// UserAddedPerFile tracks per-file user additions for accurate modification tracking.
   189→	// This enables distinguishing user self-modifications from agent modifications.
   190→	// See docs/architecture/attribution.md for details.
   191→	UserAddedPerFile map[string]int `json:"user_added_per_file,omitempty"`

   194→// NormalizeAfterLoad applies backward-compatible migrations to state loaded from disk.
   195→// Call this after deserializing a State from JSON.
   196→func (s *State) NormalizeAfterLoad(ctx context.Context) {
   197→	// Normalize legacy phase values. "active_committed" was removed with the
   198→	// 1:1 checkpoint model in favor of the state machine handling commits
   199→	// during ACTIVE phase with immediate condensation.
   200→	if s.Phase == "active_committed" {
   201→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "session")
   202→		logging.Info(logCtx, "migrating legacy active_committed phase to active",
   203→			slog.String("session_id", s.SessionID),
   204→		)
   205→		s.Phase = PhaseActive
   206→	}
   207→	// Also normalize via PhaseFromString to handle any other legacy/unknown values.
   208→	s.Phase = PhaseFromString(string(s.Phase))
   209→
   210→	// Migrate transcript fields: CheckpointTranscriptStart replaces both
   211→	// CondensedTranscriptLines and TranscriptLinesAtStart from older state files.
   212→	if s.CheckpointTranscriptStart == 0 {
   213→		if s.CondensedTranscriptLines > 0 {
   214→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.CondensedTranscriptLines
   215→		} else if s.TranscriptLinesAtStart > 0 {
   216→			s.CheckpointTranscriptStart = s.TranscriptLinesAtStart
   217→		}
   218→	}
   219→	// Clear deprecated fields so they aren't re-persisted.
   220→	// Note: this is a one-way migration. If the state is re-saved, older CLI versions
   221→	// will see 0 for these fields and fall back to scoping from the transcript start.
   222→	// This is acceptable since CLI upgrades are monotonic and the worst case is
   223→	// redundant transcript content in a condensation, not data loss.
   224→	s.CondensedTranscriptLines = 0
   225→	s.TranscriptLinesAtStart = 0
   226→
   227→	// Backfill AttributionBaseCommit for sessions created before this field existed.
   228→	// Without this, a mid-turn commit would migrate BaseCommit and the fallback in
   229→	// calculateSessionAttributions would use the migrated value, producing zero attribution.
   230→	if s.AttributionBaseCommit == "" && s.BaseCommit != "" {
   231→		s.AttributionBaseCommit = s.BaseCommit
   232→	}
   233→}
   234→
   235→// IsStale returns true when a session hasn't seen interaction for longer than
   236→// StaleSessionThreshold. Falls back to StartedAt when LastInteractionTime is
   237→// nil (sessions created before interaction tracking was added).
   238→func (s *State) IsStale() bool {
   239→	var since time.Duration
   240→	if s.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   241→		since = time.Since(*s.LastInteractionTime)
   242→	} else {
   243→		since = time.Since(s.StartedAt)
   244→	}
   245→	return since > StaleSessionThreshold
   246→}

   248→// StateStore provides low-level operations for managing session state files.
   249→//
   250→// StateStore is a primitive for session state persistence. It is NOT the same as
   251→// the Sessions interface - it only handles state files in .git/entire-sessions/,
   252→// not the full session data which includes checkpoint content.
   253→//
   254→// Use StateStore directly in strategies for performance-critical state operations.
   255→// Use the Sessions interface (when implemented) for high-level session management.
   256→type StateStore struct {
   257→	// stateDir is the directory where session state files are stored
   258→	stateDir string
   259→}
   260→
   261→// NewStateStore creates a new state store.
   262→// Uses the git common dir to store session state (shared across worktrees).
   263→func NewStateStore(ctx context.Context) (*StateStore, error) {
   264→	commonDir, err := getGitCommonDir(ctx)
   265→	if err != nil {
   266→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   267→	}
   268→	return &StateStore{
   269→		stateDir: filepath.Join(commonDir, SessionStateDirName),
   270→	}, nil
   271→}
   272→
   273→// NewStateStoreWithDir creates a new state store with a custom directory.
   274→// This is useful for testing.
   275→func NewStateStoreWithDir(stateDir string) *StateStore {
   276→	return &StateStore{stateDir: stateDir}
   277→}
   278→
   279→// Load loads the session state for the given session ID.
   280→// Returns (nil, nil) when session file doesn't exist or session is stale (not an error condition).
   281→// Stale sessions (ended longer than StaleSessionThreshold ago) are automatically deleted.
   282→func (s *StateStore) Load(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) (*State, error) {
   283→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   284→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   285→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   286→	}
   287→
   288→	root, err := os.OpenRoot(s.stateDir)
   289→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   290→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   291→	}
   292→	if err != nil {
   293→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open session state directory: %w", err)
   294→	}
   295→	defer root.Close()
   296→
   297→	fileName := sessionID + ".json"
   298→	data, err := osroot.ReadFile(root, fileName)
   299→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   300→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil // nil,nil indicates session not found (expected case)
   301→	}
   302→	if err != nil {
   303→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state: %w", err)
   304→	}
   305→
   306→	var state State
   307→	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
   308→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to unmarshal session state: %w", err)
   309→	}
   310→	state.NormalizeAfterLoad(ctx)
   311→
   312→	if state.IsStale() {
   313→		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "session")
   314→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "deleting stale session state",
   315→			slog.String("session_id", sessionID),
   316→		)
   317→		_ = s.Clear(ctx, sessionID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup of stale session
   318→		return nil, nil             //nolint:nilnil // stale session treated as not found
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	return &state, nil
   322→}
   323→
   324→// Save saves the session state atomically.
   325→func (s *StateStore) Save(ctx context.Context, state *State) error {
   326→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   327→
   328→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   329→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(state.SessionID); err != nil {
   330→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   331→	}
   332→
   333→	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.stateDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   334→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session state directory: %w", err)
   335→	}
   336→
   337→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(state, "", "  ")
   338→	if err != nil {
   339→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal session state: %w", err)
   340→	}
   341→
   342→	// Use os.Root for traversal-resistant write of temp file.
   343→	// Rename is not available on os.Root, so we keep using os.Rename.
   344→	root, err := os.OpenRoot(s.stateDir)
   345→	if err != nil {
   346→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open session state directory: %w", err)
   347→	}
   348→	defer root.Close()
   349→
   350→	fileName := state.SessionID + ".json"
   351→	tmpFileName := fileName + ".tmp"
   352→	if err := osroot.WriteFile(root, tmpFileName, data, 0o600); err != nil {
   353→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write session state: %w", err)
   354→	}
   355→
   356→	// Atomic rename: not available on os.Root, use os.Rename with validated paths.
   357→	stateFile := s.stateFilePath(state.SessionID)
   358→	tmpFile := stateFile + ".tmp"
   359→	if err := os.Rename(tmpFile, stateFile); err != nil {
   360→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to rename session state file: %w", err)
   361→	}
   362→	return nil
   363→}
   364→
   365→// Clear removes the session state file for the given session ID.
   366→func (s *StateStore) Clear(ctx context.Context, sessionID string) error {
   367→	_ = ctx // Reserved for future use
   368→
   369→	// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
   370→	if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(sessionID); err != nil {
   371→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID: %w", err)
   372→	}
   373→
   374→	// Remove all files for this session (state .json, .model hint, any future hint files).
   375→	// filepath.Glob finds matches; os.Root ensures traversal-resistant removal.
   376→	matches, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".*")) //nolint:errcheck // pattern is always valid
   377→	if len(matches) > 0 {
   378→		root, rootErr := os.OpenRoot(s.stateDir)
   379→		if rootErr != nil {
   380→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open session state directory for cleanup: %w", rootErr)
   381→		}
   382→		defer root.Close()
   383→		for _, f := range matches {
   384→			_ = osroot.Remove(root, filepath.Base(f)) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   385→		}
   386→	}
   387→
   388→	return nil
   389→}
   390→
   391→// RemoveAll removes the entire session state directory.
   392→// This is used during uninstall to completely remove all session state.
   393→func (s *StateStore) RemoveAll() error {
   394→	if err := os.RemoveAll(s.stateDir); err != nil {
   395→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to remove session state directory: %w", err)
   396→	}
   397→	return nil
   398→}
   399→
   400→// List returns all session states.
   401→func (s *StateStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]*State, error) {
   402→	entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.stateDir)
   403→	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   404→		return nil, nil
   405→	}
   406→	if err != nil {
   407→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session state directory: %w", err)
   408→	}
   409→
   410→	var states []*State
   411→	for _, entry := range entries {
   412→		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
   413→			continue
   414→		}
   415→		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") {
   416→			continue // Skip temp files
   417→		}
   418→
   419→		sessionID := strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json")
   420→		state, err := s.Load(ctx, sessionID)
   421→		if err != nil {
   422→			continue // Skip corrupted state files
   423→		}
   424→		if state == nil {
   425→			continue // Not found or stale (Load handles cleanup)
   426→		}
   427→
   428→		states = append(states, state)
   429→	}
   430→	return states, nil
   431→}
   432→
   433→// stateFilePath returns the path to a session state file.
   434→func (s *StateStore) stateFilePath(sessionID string) string {
   435→	return filepath.Join(s.stateDir, sessionID+".json")
   436→}

   438→// gitCommonDirCache caches the git common dir to avoid repeated subprocess calls.
   439→// Keyed by working directory to handle directory changes (same pattern as paths.WorktreeRoot).
   440→var (
   441→	gitCommonDirMu       sync.RWMutex
   442→	gitCommonDirCache    string
   443→	gitCommonDirCacheDir string
   444→)
   445→
   446→// ClearGitCommonDirCache clears the cached git common dir.
   447→// Useful for testing when changing directories.
   448→func ClearGitCommonDirCache() {
   449→	gitCommonDirMu.Lock()
   450→	gitCommonDirCache = ""
   451→	gitCommonDirCacheDir = ""
   452→	gitCommonDirMu.Unlock()
   453→}
   454→
   455→// getGitCommonDir returns the path to the shared git directory.
   456→// In a regular checkout, this is .git/
   457→// In a worktree, this is the main repo's .git/ (not .git/worktrees/<name>/)
   458→// The result is cached per working directory.
   459→func getGitCommonDir(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
   460→	cwd, err := os.Getwd() //nolint:forbidigo // used for cache key, not git-relative paths
   461→	if err != nil {
   462→		cwd = ""
   463→	}
   464→
   465→	// Check cache with read lock first
   466→	gitCommonDirMu.RLock()
   467→	if gitCommonDirCache != "" && gitCommonDirCacheDir == cwd {
   468→		cached := gitCommonDirCache
   469→		gitCommonDirMu.RUnlock()
   470→		return cached, nil
   471→	}
   472→	gitCommonDirMu.RUnlock()
   473→
   474→	// Cache miss — resolve via git subprocess
   475→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir")
   476→	cmd.Dir = "."
   477→	output, err := cmd.Output()
   478→	if err != nil {
   479→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get git common dir: %w", err)
   480→	}
   481→
   482→	commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
   483→
   484→	// git rev-parse --git-common-dir returns relative paths from the working directory,
   485→	// so we need to make it absolute if it isn't already
   486→	if !filepath.IsAbs(commonDir) {
   487→		commonDir = filepath.Join(".", commonDir)
   488→	}
   489→	commonDir = filepath.Clean(commonDir)
   490→
   491→	gitCommonDirMu.Lock()
   492→	gitCommonDirCache = commonDir
   493→	gitCommonDirCacheDir = cwd
   494→	gitCommonDirMu.Unlock()
   495→
   496→	return commonDir, nil
   497→}

     3→import (
     4→	"errors"
